query: Let `(Aᵢ)_{i ∈ s}` and `(Bᵢ)_{i ∈ s}` be finite families of functions on a filter `l`. If for each `i` we have `Aᵢ =O_{Cᵢ}[l] Bᵢ` (i.e. eventually `‖Aᵢ x‖ ≤ Cᵢ · ‖Bᵢ x‖`), then the sum `∑ᵢ Aᵢ` is `O_{sup Cᵢ}[l]` of the function `∑ᵢ ‖Bᵢ‖`. The constant `sup Cᵢ` is the supremum of the individual constants over the index set.
